narrative.northStar: Spotify shell, NetEase playback and lyrics
narrative.overview: Use the confirmed references as a direction for a working desktop music player: a quiet, dense library shell around music artwork, with a separate, spacious playback and lyric view. The interface uses tonal panels, restrained green signals, strong headings, and compact controls.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent navigation and transport around a separately scrolling content panel.
One selectable accent; dark is the fresh-install default, with light, automatic, and custom appearance retained.
Album artwork and timed lyric state drive the listening view.

rules.name: The Theme Variable Rule
rules.body: New shell surfaces use --color-* variables; palette values in this document describe defaults. Playback backgrounds and lyric foregrounds also have their own existing theme settings.

dos: Do preserve the fixed navigation, native caption, independent content scroll, and persistent transport.
Do use shared theme variables and retain saved light, automatic, accent, and playback preferences.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, readable metadata, and artwork-to-lyrics access.
Do render real source content or an honest loading/empty state.
donts: Don't extend the shell palette into a replacement for configurable playback or desktop-lyric themes.
Don't turn transient test tracks, loading copy, or unavailable remote recommendations into house content.
Don't infer mobile support or verified contrast across every custom background from these desktop screenshots.
